x.description: array_like Array of points. The dtype is converted to float64 or complex128 depending on whether any of the elements are complex. If `x` is scalar it is converted to a 1-D array.
constraints: x and deg must be provided

deg.description: int Degree of the resulting matrix.
constraints: x and deg must be provided

output.description: ------- ndarray The pseudo-Vandermonde matrix. The shape of the returned matrix is ``x.shape + (deg + 1,)``, where The last index is the degree of the corresponding HermiteE polynomial. The dtype will be the same as the converted `x`.

constraints: x and deg must be provided
